grades.upper_bound_mechanism: iterate comparison via remainder identity (7) + separation |x-y|>c, backward induction, interval covering
grades.notes: Identity (3) and verification complete. Necessity rigorously kills two positive values (rational+irrational cases) and the mixed 0/c case via |x-y|>c, Lemma 1, covering. However g>=0 is never proved: §3's dichotomy and Lemma 1 silently assume no negative differences; a short backward induction from (4) is missing.
